description: Web Performance Insights runs Lighthouse performance audits on web pages through its tool service, displays scores and Core Web Vitals with historical trends, retrieves real-user Chrome UX Report field data, compares or benchmarks multiple pages head-to-head, provides AI-powered recommendations to improve specific metrics, and exports audit results as downloadable PDF reports.
